UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE, Plaintiff, v. KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6, Defendants. ____________________________________/ | Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

ORDER

This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion Under Rule 26(d)(1) for Present Authorization to Serve Two Interrogatories on Meta Concerning Plaintiff’s Full Legal Name and Facebook Account (ECF No. [__]) (the “Motion”). It is hereby ORDERED that:

1.	The Motion is REFERRED to the United States Magistrate Judge for determination under 28 U.S.C. § 636(b)(1)(A).

2.	The referral expressly authorizes the Magistrate Judge to determine whether to authorize, under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 26(d)(1), service of the two interrogatories attached to the Motion as “Exhibit A — Meta — November 7, 2026 — Final” as a limited exception to the discovery posture described in ECF No. 108 and notwithstanding ECF No. 84, and to fix the periods for service and response.

Alexandria, Virginia

__________, 2026

______________________________

United States District Judge
